description: This file implements the FinishSetupSource class, which is responsible for finalizing the setup of media sources in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes callback functions for GStreamer appsrc events, manages the attachment of audio and video streams, and notifies the client of the playback state.

classes.name: FinishSetupSource
classes.description: A class that finalizes the setup of media sources by attaching audio and video streams and notifying the client of the playback state.

methods.name: FinishSetupSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FinishSetupSource with the given context, player, and client.

methods.name: ~FinishSetupSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the setup process.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the final setup steps: attaching audio and video streams, marking sources as attached, and notifying the client of the idle state.
